import copy, hashlib, json, runpy
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
hash_file=lambda path: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
report_path=root/'checks/mosaic-probe-final.json'
r=json.loads(report_path.read_text())
expected='c6c1fe92d20bffc6f109fc202d6861003e8594f73ff3495359b094328a1b66e8'
assert r['status']=='pass' and r['sources']['generator_sha256']==expected
probe=runpy.run_path(str(root/'repo/generators/02280b74c8ab/workspace/probe_mosaic.py'))
_,gen,_,_,normalize,loaded_hash=probe['load_task']()
assert loaded_hash==expected
s=next(item for item in r['samples'] if item['id']=='sample-20')
assert s['kind']=='lesson' and s['difficulty'] is None and s['seed']==2 and s['sample_index']==2 and s['requested']=={}
item=r['inputs'][s['input_sha256']]
assert s['validator_errors']==[] and item['racket']['valid_output'] and item['racket']['error'] is None
rivals={}
for name in ('stride_from_decor','fixed3_stride','stride_from_gap'):
    output=normalize(gen.CANONICAL_SHORTCUTS[name](copy.deepcopy(item['input'])))
    output_hash=probe['digest'](output)
    assert item['rivals'][name]['status']=='differs' and output_hash==item['rivals'][name]['output_sha256']
    assert output!=item['racket']['output']
    rivals[name]={'output':output,'output_shape':[len(output),len(output[0])],'output_sha256':output_hash,'matches_retained_rival_output_hash':True,'canonical_fit':r['canonical_rival_fit'][name]}
shortcuts=r['contract']['declarations']['CANONICAL_SHORTCUTS']
assert len(shortcuts)==9 and all(r['canonical_rival_fit'][name]['fits_every_usable_pair'] for name in shortcuts)
assert len(r['lessons'])==400
rotations=[rotation for lesson in r['lessons'] for rotation in lesson['rotations']]
assert len(rotations)==2000 and all(len(rotation['rivals'])==10 and set(rotation['rivals'].values())=={'refuted_by_demos'} for rotation in rotations)
batch=next(b for b in r['racket_batches'] if s['input_sha256'] in b['input_hashes'])
receipt_path=root/'checks/mosaic-probe-final-receipt.json'
original=json.loads(receipt_path.read_text())
case={'id':'decor-does-not-determine-stride','sample_id':s['id'],'generation':{'seed':s['seed'],'sample_index':s['sample_index'],'difficulty':s['difficulty'],'overrides':s['requested'],'schedule_profile':s['schedule_profile']},'input':item['input'],'input_shape':[len(item['input']),len(item['input'][0])],'input_sha256':s['input_sha256'],'validator_errors':s['validator_errors'],'observed':s['observed'],'authoritative_output':item['racket']['output'],'authoritative_output_shape':[len(item['racket']['output']),len(item['racket']['output'][0])],'authoritative_output_sha256':item['racket']['output_sha256'],'rivals':rivals}
result={'schema':'02280b74c8ab-final-counterexamples-v1','task_id':r['task_id'],'phase':'final','sources':r['sources'],'reference_evidence':{'report':'checks/mosaic-probe-final.json','report_sha256':hash_file(report_path),'receipt':'checks/mosaic-probe-final-receipt.json','receipt_sha256':hash_file(receipt_path),'argv':original['argv'],'cwd':'packet_root','actual_launch_cwd':original['cwd'],'actual_effective_cwd':original['effective_cwd'],'exit_code':original['exit_code'],'api':'arcpuzzles.Catalog.apply','reference':'canonical','batch_index':batch['batch_index'],'input_index_in_batch':batch['input_hashes'].index(s['input_sha256']),'batch_input_count':batch['input_count'],'executed_rule_hash':batch['executed_rule_hash'],'rule_text_sha256':batch['rule_text_sha256'],'rule_hash_matches_catalog':batch['rule_hash_matches_catalog']},'cases':[case],'canonical_shortcut_fit':{name:r['canonical_rival_fit'][name] for name in shortcuts},'bounded_lesson_evidence':{'seed_range_inclusive':[0,19],'sample_indices_inclusive':[0,8],'bands':[None,'easy','medium','hard'],'schedule_period':r['contract']['schedule_period'],'cyclic_starts':[0,1,2,3,4],'demonstrations':4,'query_count':1,'windows':400,'query_rotations':2000,'rival_names':r['contract']['declarations']['LESSON_COMPETITORS'],'every_rival_refuted_by_demos_in_every_rotation':True,'unique_lesson_inputs':r['totals']['lesson_unique_inputs'],'unique_inputs_per_band':{band:value['unique_inputs'] for band,value in r['totals']['per_band'].items()}},'verification_method':'Reused the saved public Catalog.apply output; executed only the existing declared rivals locally and matched their retained output hashes. No new Racket execution and no Python reference labels.','limits':['Finite declared-rival evidence, not a universal identifiability guarantee.','Overlapping windows and bands are not independent inputs.','No quantitative claim about success on superseded generator designs.']}
output_path=root/'checks/final-counterexamples.json'
with output_path.open('x') as handle:
    json.dump(result,handle,separators=(',',':'))
    handle.write('\n')
assert hash_file(root/'repo/generators/02280b74c8ab/generator.py')==expected
print(json.dumps({'case':case['id'],'seed':s['seed'],'sample_index':s['sample_index'],'input_shape':case['input_shape'],'authoritative_output':case['authoritative_output'],'rival_output':rivals['stride_from_decor']['output'],'input_sha256':case['input_sha256'],'authoritative_output_sha256':case['authoritative_output_sha256'],'rival_output_sha256':rivals['stride_from_decor']['output_sha256'],'case_file':'checks/final-counterexamples.json','case_file_sha256':hash_file(output_path)},indent=2))
